name: Homeostatic Regulation
description: Negative feedback mechanisms that maintain physiological variables around a setpoint. Implements allostasis: predictive regulation of internal state. Core principle from Cannon's work on autonomic stability; extended to neuromodulation, synaptic scaling, and network-level regulation.
key_references: Cannon, W. B. (1929). Organization for Physiological Homeostasis. Physiological Reviews, 9(3), 399-431.
Sterling, P. (2012). Allostasis: A model of predictive regulation. Physiology & Behavior, 106(1), 5-15.
empirical_evidence: Documented in temperature regulation, osmotic balance, energy metabolism, and neural excitability. Synaptic scaling adjusts global excitability over hours/days. Autonomic nervous system regulates heart rate, breathing, digestion. Allostatic mechanisms predict states and adjust metabolic resources proactively.
